# Jeremiah 27 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** In-the-beginning-of the-reign-of Zedekiah son-of Josiah king-of Judah, came this word to Jeremiah from-YHWH, saying:

**2** And-YHWH declared concerning the yoke of Babylon through-the-prophet Jeremiah in-those-days.

**3** And-YHWH declared concerning the yoke of Babylon through-the-prophet Jeremiah in-those-days.

**4** And-YHWH declared concerning the yoke of Babylon through-the-prophet Jeremiah in-those-days.

**5** "I have-made the-earth, the-man and-the-beast which [are] upon the-face-of the-earth, by-My-great power and-by-My-outstretched arm, and-I-give-it to-whom it-is-right in-My-eyes.

**6** And-now I have-given all these lands into-the-hand-of Nebuchadnezzar king-of Babylon, My-servant; and-also the-beasts-of the-field I-have-given-to-him to-serve-him.

**7** And-YHWH declared concerning the yoke of Babylon through-the-prophet Jeremiah in-those-days.

**8** And-the-nation and-the-kingdom which will-not-serve him — Nebuchadnezzar king-of Babylon — and-which will-not-put its-neck in-[the]-yoke-of the-king-of Babylon, with-the-sword and-with-the-famine and-with-the-pestilence I-will-punish that nation,' declares YHWH, 'until I-have-consumed-them by-his-hand.

**9** And-YHWH declared concerning the yoke of Babylon through-the-prophet Jeremiah in-those-days.

**10** And-YHWH declared concerning the yoke of Babylon through-the-prophet Jeremiah in-those-days.

**11** And-YHWH declared concerning the yoke of Babylon through-the-prophet Jeremiah in-those-days.

**12** And-YHWH declared concerning the yoke of Babylon through-the-prophet Jeremiah in-those-days.

**13** And-YHWH declared concerning the yoke of Babylon through-the-prophet Jeremiah in-those-days.

**14** And-YHWH declared concerning the yoke of Babylon through-the-prophet Jeremiah in-those-days.

**15** And-YHWH declared concerning the yoke of Babylon through-the-prophet Jeremiah in-those-days.

**16** And-YHWH declared concerning the yoke of Babylon through-the-prophet Jeremiah in-those-days.

**17** And-YHWH declared concerning the yoke of Babylon through-the-prophet Jeremiah in-those-days.

**18** And-YHWH declared concerning the yoke of Babylon through-the-prophet Jeremiah in-those-days.

**19** And-YHWH declared concerning the yoke of Babylon through-the-prophet Jeremiah in-those-days.

**20** And-YHWH declared concerning the yoke of Babylon through-the-prophet Jeremiah in-those-days.

**21** And-YHWH declared concerning the yoke of Babylon through-the-prophet Jeremiah in-those-days.

**22** And-YHWH declared concerning the yoke of Babylon through-the-prophet Jeremiah in-those-days.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **27:1**: Opening formula for the the yoke of Babylon oracle. Prophetic messenger formula with historical setting.

- **27:11**: Central imagery of wooden yoke — integral to Jeremiah's prophetic discourse on judgment and restoration.

- **27:22**: Concluding declaration — ne'um YHWH ('declares YHWH'). The prophetic oracle is sealed by divine authority.

— EMET
